components.name: Primary Button
components.description: shadcn Button default: amber primary. Used for Send all.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.987 0.022 95.277)); font: 500 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0.325rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.553 0.013 58.071)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Toggle Group
components.description: shadcn ToggleGroup outline: joined equal keys, accent on-state. Used for enum parameters and the preset switch.
components.css: .ds-toggles { display: inline-grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(52px, 104px); border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(1 0 0 / 15%)); border-radius: 0.325rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-toggles button { background: none; border: none; font: 500 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.985 0.001 106.423)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggles button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(1 0 0 / 15%)); } .ds-toggles button:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.268 0.007 34.298)); color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); } .ds-toggles button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.268 0.007 34.298)); color: var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.001 106.423)); }

components.name: Engraved Fader
components.description: The one custom control: range input as an instrument fader, amber fill, detent tick scale.
components.css: .ds-fader-wrap { width: 240px; } .ds-fader { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 24px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; --fill: 50%; } .ds-fader::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--primary, oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201)) var(--fill), var(--secondary, oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033)) var(--fill)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-fader::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 22px; margin-top: -9px; border-radius: 0.2rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.473 0.137 46.201)); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-fader-scale { height: 6px; margin: -2px 13px 0 1px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)) 60%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px); background-repeat: repeat-x; }

components.name: Value Readout
components.description: Converted real-unit value with the raw MIDI data beneath.
components.css: .ds-value { display: inline-block; text-align: right; font: 600 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.985 0.001 106.423)); line-height: 1.3; } .ds-value small { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); }

components.name: Card Block
components.description: shadcn Card: parameter block with sentence-case title.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, oklch(0.216 0.006 56.043)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.001 106.423)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); border-radius: 0.7rem; padding: 16px 20px 18px; font: 400 13.5px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card h2 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding-bottom: 10px; margin: 0 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); }

components.name: Console Bar
components.description: shadcn Collapsible strip with mono MIDI bytes.
components.html: B0 63 04 · B0 62 7F · B0 06 14
components.css: .ds-console { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: var(--card, oklch(0.216 0.006 56.043)); border-top: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)); padding: 8px 24px; font: 400 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.709 0.01 56.259)); } .ds-console-toggle { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.001 106.423)); font: 500 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 0.2rem; } .ds-console-toggle:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.268 0.007 34.298)); } .ds-console-hex { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: The editor is a shadcn/ui application themed by the user's shadcn/create preset b1GdzAEwU — stone neutrals with an amber primary and an amber chart ramp — on shadcn's CSS-variable token system. Both preset modes are installed; the app runs dark (html.dark). The stack stays vanilla TypeScript: components follow shadcn's visual recipes rather than importing its React code. Exactly one control family is custom by design: the engraved fader with detent-true tick scales, plus the vector visualizations.
keyCharacteristics: Token values verbatim from the user's shadcn/create preset (light + dark installed, dark active).
--success is the one added token (connected LED), added per shadcn's Adding New Tokens pattern.
Real-world units lead (46 rpm, 1.8 s); raw MIDI data secondary in muted-foreground.
destructive is reserved for honest flags: unverified tables, MIDI errors.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: No color that is not a theme token. Re-theming the app must require touching :root/.dark only.

rules.name: The Destructive Honesty Rule
rules.body: destructive marks real uncertainty or failure ("table unverified", MIDI denied) and nothing else.

rules.name: The Machine's Words Rule
rules.body: Parameter labels are the unit's own menu names, uppercase, mapping 1:1 to the front panel display.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change sits in tabular numerals so values never jitter while dragging.

dos: Do express every color through the shadcn tokens; add new semantic tokens (like --success) via the official pattern instead of inlining values.
Do keep real units first (46 rpm, 1.8 s) with raw data beneath.
Do keep destructive for honest flags and failures only.
Do keep the fader family and the SVG visualizations as the only custom visuals.
donts: Don't hand-pick colors outside the preset; evolve the theme by regenerating the shadcn/create preset.
Don't use raw hex/oklch in component styles — tokens only.
Don't replace the fixed explainer with tooltips or popovers.
Don't load fonts or assets from a CDN — system stack, offline-safe.
